title: Predicting a son's height from his father's
caption: With ρ = 0.5 and equal SDs the best prediction is 175 + 0.5(189 − 175) = 182 cm: halfway back towards the mean, below the line y = x.
alt: Graph with the dashed line y = x and the regression line y = 175 + 0.5(x − 175); the point (189, 182) lies on the regression line.
description: A father of 189 cm is 14 cm above the mean.
The expected son's height moves only ρ = 0.5 of that: 7 cm above the mean.
The prediction (189, 182) lies on the regression line, below y = x.

checks.name: the line passes through the mean point (175, 175)
